Since it is too early for match threads in voat (and we are in the off season anyway), I thought I'd share some of the links I use to follow match scores and commentary when I'm not able to stream.

For fixture lists and live scores I use FlashScore
They cover all domestic and international football matches on the planet. They also have live stats for matches and some commentary.

For live detailed commentary, I use SportsMole
They have detailed commentary that is updated every 2 min or so depending on the match events of course. They often include interesting stats or tweets and sometimes a bit of analysis in their commentary during the match. They cover the 4 major leagues in Europe plus some international competitions as well.

For match and goal highlights, I use Goal 24/7
They have good quality video highlights of matches from Europe's top 5 leagues, plus major international competitions as well. They don't use the shitty 'playwire' video player so you can watch videos with any browser. They also provide match reports with stats. Be warned that they show the scores of all matches on their home page.
